headline: Very early Wednesday IST, Day 221, T+10 — and for the first time since Aug 9 the brief carries two stories instead of one. The bad one first: Aug 18 became day 220, the first day this machine produced NO edition at all — the PM and the cofounder sweep were skipped outright (the scheduler quietly moved both to Aug 19), and the AM only woke at day's end inside a six-task burst at 18:29–18:39Z, 17.7 hours off its cron. That burst run is the one writing this sentence, which is why your morning brief was born at 00:09 IST. Underneath it, the number that matters did not move: a live read of the mailbox across every Meta domain returns EMPTY ten days past T-0 — no ad review, no billing, no lead — and W15, the one-sentence question opened Aug 12, is now seven mornings unanswered while the last recorded founder decision anywhere stays Aug 5, fourteen days old. Now the good one: while the ads lane idled, the build lane shipped. orayalabs.ai was rebuilt end-to-end on Aug 18 — 49 indexable static pages and ~31,000 words of crawlable text replacing a live site that serves 45 characters and is literally invisible to ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity (their crawlers never execute JavaScript). It sits one founder sign-off — pricing + integrations — from deploy, and it is the one growth lane that needs nobody's ad review. One sentence and one sign-off would make today the most decisive day this company has had in two weeks. And a footnote with a fuse on it: PhantomBuster's trial dies TODAY, which will kill the W14 phantom by default — don't let a billing lapse impersonate a founder decision; write OFF or KEEP on the record first.
